binCount.description:
Sets number of possible values the hash function will map element too. Larger hash means more accurate estimate,
but larger structure in CountMinSketch. Must be a power of two for fast modulo calculations.

hashCount.description:
Number of hash functions used in CountMinSketch. Larger hash means more accurate estimate, but larger structure
in CountMinSketch.

trackTopCount.description: Sets CountMinSketch to keep track of top k elements

enableTrackTop.description: Enable or disable the tracking of top most frequent elements. Enabling this will decrease performance.

title:
